body.prose:
Asking what truly matters, and what potential it has, gives ground to rest on. That ground is understood by what is most decisive for it, its ontology: what exists, said as knowledge in language, so that a graph of knowledge can be built on it. In glass that is [the primitives](ref:01M6F8G0M0JDVENGCEYER4VYDZ).

So once a question is settled, as the store's objects and the relations now are, attention goes back from it to the grounds, rather than on to more of the same detail.

*The author's, 2026-11-02.*
body.title: What matters is the potential
